pass_1_source_refetch.notes: All 12 cited source URLs were verified via independent web searches. Key claims attributed to each source (Colorado General Assembly bill pages, Akin Gump, Clark Hill, Colorado Sun, Colorado Newsline, CPR News, Colorado House Democrats, ABA, NAAG) are consistent with the information found in those sources.

details: SB 24-205 signed May 17, 2024 -- CONFIRMED via multiple law firm analyses and Colorado General Assembly records
Characterized as 'first comprehensive state AI law' -- CONFIRMED via Wilson Sonsini, Jackson Lewis, ABA, and multiple other legal analyses
SB 25B-004 signed August 28, 2025 -- CONFIRMED via Colorado General Assembly records and multiple law firm analyses
Enforcement delay from February 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026 -- CONFIRMED via Akin Gump, Alston & Bird, Baker Botts, Clark Hill, and official bill page
Special session failed to reach compromise on substantive amendments -- CONFIRMED via Colorado Sun, CPR News reporting
Robert Rodriguez identified as Senate Majority Leader (D-Denver) -- CONFIRMED via Colorado Sun, CPR News
Rodriguez initially proposed 'AI Sunshine Act' (SB 4) as comprehensive rewrite -- CONFIRMED via Colorado Sun, ABA analysis
Rodriguez amended SB 4 to simple delay after negotiations collapsed -- CONFIRMED via Colorado Sun, CPR News
SB 25B-004 does not alter substantive requirements of SB 24-205 -- CONFIRMED via Akin Gump, Clark Hill, multiple legal analyses
HB 26-1263 introduced February 19, 2026 -- CONFIRMED via Colorado General Assembly records, LegiScan
Sponsors: Representatives Sean Camacho and Javier Mabrey -- CONFIRMED via Colorado General Assembly records, CPR News, Colorado Newsline
Effective date January 1, 2027 -- CONFIRMED via FastDemocracy bill tracking, Colorado General Assembly
Committee vote 10-3 on March 26, 2026 -- CONFIRMED via FastDemocracy, Colorado Newsline, Colorado House Democrats
Referred to Committee of the Whole -- CONFIRMED via FastDemocracy bill tracking
House Second Reading, laid over daily as of March 31 -- CONFIRMED via LegiScan status tracking
$1,000 per violation civil penalty -- CONFIRMED via Colorado General Assembly bill summary
Violations constitute deceptive trade practice enforceable by AG -- CONFIRMED via Colorado General Assembly bill summary
Disclosure requirement for minors interacting with AI -- CONFIRMED via CPR News, Colorado Newsline
Anti-manipulation provisions (no rewards to increase engagement) -- CONFIRMED via CPR News, Colorado Newsline
Content restrictions on sexually explicit material for minors -- CONFIRMED via CPR News, Colorado Newsline
Parental controls for children under 13 -- CONFIRMED via CPR News (age 13 consistent with COPPA threshold and bill text references)
Suicide prevention resource requirements -- CONFIRMED via CPR News
No substantive amendments to SB 24-205 enacted as of April 2026 -- CONFIRMED; no search results indicate any amending legislation has been enacted
